title: RecordStore keeps its own copy of the cloud account (cloudAccount) and of the pending-marker target (marksPending), pushed by CloudSync, rather than reading them from CloudConnection
evidence: Source union (US-25 AC11o): the account and the pending marker are one Link inside RecordStore.source, set only by the linked event (RecordStore.link, CloudSync.linkStore's one call), assigned only on change; cloudAccount, cloudName and marksPending are deleted. recordSource derives from the source, so a stale cloudName cannot be read. Not a behaviour bug: the pin RecordSourcePinsTests testTheLinkMovesWithTheSourceAndOnlyCloudSyncSetsIt keeps the AC10 rule (no source while connected but not open); RecordSourceTests testAnEqualLinkAssignsNothing. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:47-50; CloudSync.linkStore (US-25 AC11m, US-72 AC10)
